result.reason: The redline adds affiliates and contractors and makes the royalty-free/fully paid licence perpetual and irrevocable, but it does not expressly make the licence transferable to a successor. Allowing successors to exercise rights on Company’s behalf is not equivalent to transfer in an M&A transaction. It also unnecessarily expands substantive use rights by adding worldwide scope, distribution, use of Contractor Information alone, and use for any business purpose, potentially conflicting with the existing restriction on use and resale. Drafting is generally clear but uses the inconsistent term “Contractor Information” and handles successor rights imprecisely.
